name: clipfx
description: ClipFX: a platform where developers publish, distribute and track their products. frontend/ runs on Cloudflare Workers, backend/ on Render, data in Cloudflare D1 and R2.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && wrangler deploy -c frontend/wrangler.jsonc
